findings.finding: Traced in the pinned model (scripts/trace_s06.py). The ARM run takes the first two queued failures: ARM fails clean (the AFTER-triggered position) and INVALIDATED fails torn, leaving TORN in the journal. The GENERATION_STATUS reads journalDigest over [BIND, TORN]. CLOSE_GENERATION on the HELD generation then writes no record at all (response OK, state HELD, deniedActionIds []). The remaining queued failure is taken by GATE_RESTART: RESTARTED fails, INVALIDATED succeeds, and the final journal is [BIND, TORN, INVALIDATED]. So the intent's 'the queued remainder spills into the CLOSE run' is wrong: the remainder spills into the restart, and S06, unlike S01-S04, carries a pending failure across GATE_RESTART. That is consistent with T104 and harmless to what S06 pins, because the distinguishing read happens before the restart. Separately, README line 10 still says the file adds five transcripts; there are six.
findings.requiredChange: Change S06's intent (and the README row) to say the remainder fails the restart's RESTARTED record, because CLOSE_GENERATION on a HELD generation writes no record, as T104 does for a pending NEXT. Optionally say the pinned read is before the restart. Change 'five transcripts' to 'six transcripts'. Text only; no expected value changes.
